title: Highly Discreet, Operations-Approved Executive Placement Engine
content:
★★★★★ | Anonymous candidate-submitted review · Chief Operating Officer, Australia
Submitted October 4, 2026

Stealth career transitions at the COO level require absolute confidentiality and strict procedural control. My search in the Australian market took exactly nine months from my initial launch in early January 2026, and the agency protected my professional footprint perfectly from start to finish.

The operational setup inside their shared candidate dashboard is highly efficient. I had final approval power over every single targeted application, ensuring that no document left the agency without a strict compliance check. Because they use human verification rather than automated software, the quality of corporate connections remained exceptionally high throughout the entire cycle.

Where they truly bring elite value is the final contract negotiation phase. They supplied highly detailed market compensation benchmarks and actively co-wrote the counter-offer scripts for my base, bonus structures, and equity terms. They do not hand you off to junior staff or offshore desks. You work directly with a dedicated principal from day one until the file closes. Highly recommended for high-stakes operations.
